name: Sarz
bio: One of the most influential producers in the Afrobeats space, Sarz has shaped the sound of Nigerian music for over a decade. From classic flips to genre-defining originals, his production work spans collaborations with some of Africa's biggest artists.

name: Ayra Starr
bio: Ayra Starr emerged as one of the defining voices of a new generation of Afrobeats. With a distinctive vocal style and a confident creative presence, she has built a global audience while staying rooted in Nigerian youth culture.

name: Amaarae
bio: Amaarae has carved a distinct lane blending Afropop, alternative R&B, and experimental sounds. Her music connects Ghana, the diaspora, and global alternative audiences with a style that feels effortlessly boundary-crossing.
